title: Each value in a cell takes its own rule

version_files.format: ` * [VERSION] x.y.z` comment line, carried into js/round_dynamic.js by the build

repo_conventions.test_command: node chrome-extension/tests.js && node js/tests.js && node js/doc-tests.js && node claude-code-plugin/tests.js && node scripts/build-sheets.js --check
repo_conventions.branch_naming: <type>/<label>, type one of feature, fix, refactor, docs, chore, plan; each sprint names its branch

sprints.label: date-placement
sprints.goal: Each date in a cell takes its own patch and its own text-piece check.
sprints.scope: See source_markdown section 5, Sprint 1. dates.js: move the body of the roundDateText loop (:250-262) into roundDate(date, granularity), which returns one date's new text; roundDateText loses its last production reader and goes; the number tests keep their expected strings through one helper in the test file. table.js classifiedCellPatches (:68): a date cell gives one patch per changed date, at lead + date.start; a time cell keeps its one patch. placement.js placeClassification (:63): keep only the dates that sit in one text piece; a time cell's trimmed text gets the same check; a cell left with no date skips. content.js: remove cellPatches and isSplitDateOrTime (:831-841), and merge the 'split number' and 'split date or time' counts into one count of split values (:273-279, :865, :884). Rebuild js/round_dynamic.js and claude-code-plugin/hooks/library.js. Docs: vocabulary 'placement step' and 'left as written' (docs: commit); docs/design.md placement text; test page section 25 gains the two split-date rows and the footnote-link row.
sprints.out_of_scope: A second kind of value in a cell; any change to which cells hold a date.
acceptance_criteria: A synthetic sentence with a link piece and an italic piece, holding 'December 1965' and 'February 1966' each in one piece, becomes 'In 1965, … in 1966.' on both table kinds.
A date split across two tags beside a whole date at month: the split date stays, the whole date becomes '2024-04', and the debug row counts one split value.
A cell with leading spaces patches at the right position.
The data test returns false for a table whose only date is split.
Sheets, doc-example, and plugin suites pass with no edits.
sprints.dev_notes: Output changes only in cells with a split date or time; per-date patches add up to the old whole-cell patch elsewhere because dates never overlap and patches apply from the end of the text. 'Jun 2020' followed by a footnote link now becomes '2020 [1]'. Date bounds index the trimmed text; placement and patches count in the classified text, so add the leading whitespace length. Placement runs before the column post-pass, so a split ambiguous date takes no part in its column's reading with no extra code (decision 10). Regression fixtures are synthetic; the capture in docs/private never enters the repository.

sprints.label: stretch-list
sprints.goal: The ladder returns a list of stretches in place of one mode, with every result unchanged.
sprints.scope: See source_markdown sections 3.1 and 5, Sprint 2. classifyCell returns { stretches: Stretch[], split?: true }, where Stretch is { kind: 'number', start, end, num } | { kind: 'date', start, end, ...date reader fields } | { kind: 'time', start, end, ...time reader fields }, in text order, positions in the classified text; a skipped cell holds []. mode, reason, and pending go. The early returns stay. Move the 13 readers: resolveAmbiguousDates (table.js:34) maps over date stretches, with isAmbiguousDateClassification (table.js:27) and resolveAmbiguousDateClassification (ladder.js:235) folded in; datasetMaxMagnitude (table.js:51) and numericPreviewCells (content.js:600) read number stretches only; holdsRoundableCell (detect.js:263) any stretch; placeClassification one filter over every stretch; classifiedCellPatches one loop with one branch per kind; classifyTableCell (classify.js:78) 'pieces-changed' returns an empty list; Sheets input step (js/src/entry.js:100, :124) makes the number-cell classification one number stretch and textResult checks for a number stretch; plugin text table step unchanged. Docs (docs: commit): add 'stretch' to the vocabulary; retire 'mode'; restate 'classification', 'classified cell', 'pure cell', 'extracted cell'; docs/design.md:27; docs/capability-map.md.
sprints.out_of_scope: Any change to what a cell becomes.
acceptance_criteria: No expected output changes in any suite or the build check.
Assertions on mode or reason become assertions on stretches or on output (about 50 in the ladder tests, 15 in detection, 8 in the table step, 4 in the rounding pass).
No reader of mode, reason, or pending is left in chrome-extension/, js/src/, or claude-code-plugin/hooks/.
js/round_dynamic.js and claude-code-plugin/hooks/library.js match the build.
sprints.dev_notes: Every skip reason a debug row prints keeps its text; if a debug row reads reason, derive the text from the stretch list or the placement result, not from a stored field. A held value is never stored; the ladder still covers its characters so no other reader takes them.

sprints.label: mixed-cell-stretches
sprints.goal: Every number, date, and time in a cell takes its own rule and switch.
sprints.scope: See source_markdown sections 3.2, 3.3, and 5, Sprint 3, and decisions 1 to 12 in section 6. The ladder runs the readers in section 3.2's order in place of the early returns: cell gate; ISO date-time inside words or whole cell; findDates on text with ISO spans blanked; clock times inside words with superscripts blanked; whole-cell number shapes only in a cell with no date or time stretch; the number reader with every date and time span masked; a number held when a touching currency or percent sign meets an off switch. ISO separator per section 3.3, one 'separator' field on the date stretch. Remove with exports and tests: readTimeCell, the whole-cell time and ISO patterns, roundTimeText (replaced by one per-stretch time step on roundClockTime), getClockTimeMaskedRanges, parseISODateTime, isTimeLike, isDateTimeLike, isDateLike, the early returns, and the currency and percent branches of getExclusionReason. js/round-dynamic-cases.json gains mixed rows. Docs: vocabulary 'clock time', 'masked range', 'exclusion', 'impossible date', 'granularity' (docs: commit); docs/design.md:29, :53; docs/capability-map.md; chrome-extension/README.md; js/README.md and js/tests-googlesheets-tab.md; the plugin test prompt's table gains a cell with a date beside a number. Test page: sections 2, 4, 9, 35, and a new section 'Cells that mix dates, times, and numbers' unless section 34a already holds those shapes.
sprints.out_of_scope: The weekday left beside a simplified written date; the quarter's year that reads as a number; the Outlook table swap; Python dates and times.
acceptance_criteria: Every row of the acceptance table in source_markdown section 5, Sprint 3, passes (dates at year, times at hour, currency and percent on unless stated), e.g. 'Paid $12,345 on November 09 2026' becomes 'Paid $10,000 on 2026' and 'Monday, November 09 2026 at 19:54 UTC' becomes 'Monday, 2026 at 20:00 UTC'.
Every row of the ISO date-time results table in source_markdown section 6 passes.
'Deployed 2026-11-09T19:54:00Z, 12,345 users' becomes 'Deployed 2026 20:00, 10,000 users' in the extension and 'Deployed 2026-11-09T19:54:00Z, 10,000 users' in Sheets.
Single-value cells ('Jun 2020 - Dec 2020', '2020-07-21' at month, '02134', '$1,234', 'Lap 3:43.13', 'Meeting at 24:00') give today's result.
js/round-dynamic-cases.json holds mixed rows and the Sheets, extension, and Python suites run them.
sprints.dev_notes: The PR states the changes a reader sees beyond the named examples: with default settings an ISO date-time now changes its date; a number beside a date counts toward the largest value and joins the lens preview pool; in Sheets a number beside a date now rounds; a duration inside words rounds with Times on. Kept as today: a date inside a quoted span inside words still changes; a race time stays; a quoted cell, an identifier shape, the first row and column, and the range expression hold the whole cell. findDates finds no date in '2026-11-09T19:54' because its end test rejects 'T', so the ISO reader runs first and blanks its span. Identifier masks must not run before dates: getIdentifierMaskedRanges('2020-07-21') returns 5 to 7. Add the minor label to the PR before merge.
